summary: Iteration 5 — FINAL validation with REAL ElevenLabs TTS now live (Creator plan). Backend regression: 27/27 pytest green. All 4 voice IDs (Mia/Oliver/Aria/Marcus) tested via /api/tts/preview — each returns a valid base64 data:audio/mpeg URL (~17-18KB for 'Hello.'). Full UI E2E verified end-to-end: admin login → Presenters 'Hear voice' (TTS roundtrip 178KB audio_url) → Studio form (Penthouse/Sydney/3 beds/2 baths/Harbour view+pool) → Generate with GPT-5.2 (~30s, real script rendered) → 'Hear it' (TTS 200 OK) → 'Save to projects' (POST /projects 200) → project visible in /app/projects → filter-draft works → delete returns 200 + 'Deleted' toast + empty state. Platform is production-ready for the AI script→voice→save→record loop.
